compendium.summary: Find a known object within the spell's restrictions.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
tactics: Search for a familiar specific object you previously saw within 30 feet, or the nearest object of a stated kind. It gives direction within 1,000 feet; lead blocks the direct path.
A search grid plus Phantom Steed can cover a large area while this spell is active. Cast the transport ritual first: ritual casting itself requires concentration and would interrupt Locate Object.
Treat clothes, insignia or stolen gear as clues only when the spell's familiarity/category requirements are actually met. It locates objects, not an arbitrarily named creature.
At Wizard 18 it is eligible for Spell Mastery because its casting time is an action, but its concentration requirement remains.
